text: The report records persistent workforce vacancies.
Recruitment remained difficult throughout the year.
Staffing shortages affected continuity of care.
Unsafe workload pressure was escalated to the board.
Waiting lists increased after demand rose.
The service backlog was discussed by commissioners.
Low pay was identified as a retention concern.
The advertised salary did not attract applicants.
Commission capacity could not meet local need.
Workforce pressure created an immediate clinical risk.
Vacancies left the safeguarding rota uncovered.
The meeting approved the minutes of the previous meeting.
Members noted the publication date of the annual report.
The chair invited questions before closing the item.
